insurer_name: Tata AIG General Insurance Company Limited
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Maternity Care: 2-year waiting (reducible to 1 year via add-on). Newborn from day 0 if both parents insured (up to 5 years). Cover ceasing age: none.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured (Medical Expenses for medically necessary treatment)
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Indemnity-based. Optional 'Room Category Select' allows upgrade.

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Excludes enteral feeding and end-of-life care.

ayush_coverage.limit_text: In-patient/Day care AYUSH plus pre/post hospitalization

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Maternity Care add-on (Maternity expenses + Delivery Complications + First-year Vaccinations of newborn)
maternity_coverage.notes: 2-year waiting (reducible to 1 year via Reduction of Maternity Care Waiting Period add-on).

newborn_coverage.limit_text: Newborn from day 0 (if both parents insured)
newborn_coverage.notes: Covered to age 5 under family floater.

organ_donor_expenses.limit_text: Organ donor harvesting expenses (insured must be recipient)

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Restore Infinity Plus - unlimited reinstatement of base SI if SI + Cumulative Bonus insufficient

room_rent_capping: Per Schedule; Room Category Select add-on lets policyholder choose category
copayment_trigger_notes: Aggregate Deductible add-on optionally lowers premium with policy-level deductible.

disease_wise_sub_limits.infinite_advantage_addon: Removes annual SI limit for one claim during policy lifetime
disease_wise_sub_limits.early_access_addon: Single premium multi-year SI available any time within policy period

permanent_exclusions: Maternity (unless Maternity Care add-on with waiting completed)
temporary_exclusions: Maternity Care: 24 months (or 12 months via add-on)
notable_exclusions_summary: Wide-relationship indemnity plan with Restore Infinity Plus (unlimited reinstatement). Multiple optional add-ons (Maternity, Infinite Advantage, Room Category, Aggregate Deductible). Zone-based premium with discounts up to 25% (Young Family / Professional / Multi-Individual).
claim_process_summary: Cashless via Tata AIG network. Toll-free 1800 266 7780 (senior citizens 1800 22 9966).
available_riders: Reduction of Maternity Care Waiting Period
